status: Retrospective exploratory extension. Decisions below specify this reproducible run. The annual counts were already known.

experiments.service_context: Retain 2013–2023 for both first-event series, all-cause and broad circulatory episodes in all hospitals, and the HA-only all-cause sensitivity. Index each to its own 2019 total. Verify provider sums and overlapping Digest editions. The series may overlap and have different eligibility.
experiments.hindcast: Predict each of 2017, 2018 and 2019 using earlier observations only. Reserve 2020 as a descriptive stress case. Carry the previous count forward or extrapolate the unweighted OLS trend in log counts over all prior years or the last three. Keep every result. Never choose a winning model on these folds.
experiments.weather_design: For all six weather exposures measure unweighted within-calendar variation in the full 132 months and disjoint 84- and 48-month windows. Rebuild the four-df natural spline and month indicators in each window. Match the released full-design correlations. Rank squared residuals for concentration.
experiments.weather_models: Verify all twelve original full-series lag-six p-values against the released Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment and retain all four uncertainty constructions. Output the archived estimates and do no outcome fitting.
experiments.annual_changes: Calculate each annual change against its immediate predecessor. For CHD and HF, report the eligible person-time ratio that gives equal recorded-event rates in that year and 2019. This is an algebraic threshold, with no empirical denominator.

stopping_rule: Keep discordant results. A missing, duplicate, changed or inconsistent input fails the run. A question requiring observation history, person-time or endpoint codes returns to the responsible analyst. These checks cannot choose a confirmatory exposure or estimate an intervention effect.
